answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Certified head chef kitchen record with chefs association endorsement, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 704 aliases would need 704 separate proofs, each costing about 119 POA or 17 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Hold the karst up to the light, weigh the ocean of the attack, and keep the ridge of the verdict where everyone can audit it. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
